title: One card per page
body: Each card says what its page holds and where that comes from — measured by a device, written by hand, or not yet sourced at all. No card carries a number: a card is JSON baked at build time and could only ever show a value that was true when it was typed, which is exactly the kind of confident stale figure the page it summarises would contradict. Tap a card to read the real thing.

items.title: Meals
items.subtitle: What was eaten
items.body: Empty. There is no store behind this page yet — no table, no file tree, no calendar category — so it records nothing and shows nothing rather than an example week.

items.title: Planner
items.subtitle: What is meant to be eaten
items.body: Empty, for the same reason as Meals. A plan is dated, so the cheapest home for it is a category on the CalDAV entries Agenda and Todo already read.

items.title: Tracking
items.subtitle: What a device measured
items.body: Real. The Nutrition metric of the Health Connect taxonomy — energy from NutritionRecord, volume from HydrationRecord — averaged per day over the last 7 and 30 days. Empty on this phone until a producer syncs those records in, and the page says which permission is missing when one is.

items.title: Gym
items.subtitle: The plan
items.body: Written by hand, and the only page here that is a decision rather than a measurement. An ABC split on free weights — push, pull, legs — with every movement named in English and Portuguese, its working sets, its rest, a form note and its own drawing.

items.title: Timeline
items.subtitle: One day, every metric
items.body: Real. Pick a date and read what Health Connect holds for it across the whole taxonomy. It moved here from the Health level so that a day of training reads next to the plan it was training for.

items.title: Steps
items.subtitle: Daily walking
items.body: Real. Steps, kilometres and active calories, averaged per day over the last 7 and 30 days, from whatever syncs into Health Connect. Not the phone's own step counter — that would be a second source disagreeing with this one on the same screen.
